summary: Dianthus Therapeutics filed an 8-K to disclose an updated corporate presentation posted on its investor relations website. The presentation includes interim responder analysis data from the first 40 patients completing Part A of the Phase 3 CAPTIVATE trial for claseprubart in CIDP. No special situation event—such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or management change—is described. This is a routine disclosure of clinical trial data, not a transformative corporate event.
